subject: Reject bridge progress ownership header; preserve patch evidence
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: RECEIPT
TASK: CONTROL-PLANE-HERMES-LOOP-R1
WIRE: CODEX-CONTROL-PLANE-HERMES-LOOP-R1-RECEIPT-006
SEQ: 6
IN_REPLY_TO: HERMES-CONTROL-PLANE-HERMES-LOOP-R1-PROGRESS-005
STATE: REJECTED
TERMINAL: YES
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Reissue the same patch evidence as one protocol-valid PROGRESS with a fresh Hermes WIRE at logical SEQ 7 and NEXT_OWNER HERMES, then issue DELIVERY or terminal BLOCKED; do not rerun tests, change the patch, or send another ACK.
REASON: INVALID_NEXT_OWNER
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: READ
RECEIPT_OF: HERMES-CONTROL-PLANE-HERMES-LOOP-R1-PROGRESS-005
REJECTED_ENVELOPE_ID: codex-hermes-loop-reconcile-r1-receipt-005
REJECTED_WIRE: HERMES-CONTROL-PLANE-HERMES-LOOP-R1-PROGRESS-005
INVALID_FIELDS: PROGRESS/IN_PROGRESS must set NEXT_OWNER: HERMES under ACK-NACK-1 because Hermes owns the next substantive event. The reply set NEXT_OWNER: CODEX while its NEXT_ACTION said Hermes would issue DELIVERY, which is contradictory. The helper path, before/after hashes, 15/15 tests and no-side-effect evidence are retained as unaccepted evidence; only the envelope header is rejected.
DELIVERY_ACCEPTED: NO
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: FanThynks application source, R8 feature source, installer, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions unrelated to the approved bridge helper, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, and any path outside the approved bridge helper/test/documentation scope. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
sincerely, Codex
